name: Chain Trap ~Fukushuu no In-wana~
source:
Main character is mistaken for a pervert in a packed train on his way to university. He gets imprisoned and condemned by society. Upon release he sets to have his revenge over people responsible for his demise.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在搭乘拥挤的电车前往大学时，被误认为痴汉。他因此蒙冤入狱，也遭到整个社会的唾弃。重获自由后，他誓要向所有毁掉自己人生的人复仇。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
